mapper.select: SELECT up.* FROM user_preorders up INNER JOIN games g ON up.game_id = g.id WHERE up.status = 'PENDING_RELEASE' AND ( (g.release_status = 'RELEASED') OR (g.preorder_unlock_date IS NOT NULL AND g.preorder_unlock_date <= #{now}) OR (g.release_status = 'CROWDFUNDING' AND g.current_funding >= g.crowdfunding_goal) )
